descriptions.ordinary-resend: Resend the ordinary recovery code only to the account's verified recovery destination.
descriptions.ordinary-replace: After an identity check, replace the ordinary recovery email. The user must verify the new address before using it.
descriptions.ordinary-approve: Issue one short-lived approval for the current ordinary reset ceremony. This does not reset a password.
descriptions.migration-resend: Resend the code only for the exact active migration continuation.
descriptions.migration-replace: After an identity check, replace the recovery email for the exact active migration continuation.
descriptions.migration-approve: Issue one short-lived approval only for the exact active migration recovery ceremony.
descriptions.resend: Resend the migration code only to the user's already verified recovery destination.
descriptions.replace: After completing an identity check, replace the recovery destination. The user must verify the new address by code before it can be used.
descriptions.approve: Issue one short-lived approval for the user's current reset ceremony. This does not reset the password or create a permanent bypass.
descriptions.reconcile: Verify the intended password against the exact bound directory identity and complete a blocked reset. This never repeats the password write.
descriptions.temporary: After completing an identity check, issue a random local temporary password that must be changed before access is granted.
descriptions.resolve: Administrator manual backoffice operation: resolve one exact pending temporary-issue or required-change operation after the original writers and directory operation are independently confirmed settled.
